_comment: DRAFT metadata for the first pyproteus reference-data record on Zenodo (legacy deposit API 'metadata' object). Nothing has been created or published. Fill the creators and check every field before use; see README.md in this folder.

metadata.title: pyproteus reference data: MATLAB PROTEUS 1.1.0 (commit 8d37938) outputs for parity testing
metadata.description:
Frozen inputs and outputs of MATLAB PROTEUS (oracle commit 8d37938, revamp branch; to be re-pinned to v1.1.0), used by the Python port pyproteus to check parity in continuous integration without MATLAB.

One HDF5 file per case: single function calls (module references) and end-to-end RF simulations (full runs: tiny, small, medium) with the k-Wave 1.4.1 C++ binary. Every file records the MATLAB version, the PROTEUS commit, the k-Wave version and binary (path, build, SHA-256), seeds and creation date. File format: docs/REFERENCE_DATA.md in the pyproteus repository. Exported with tools/export_reference/ through the MATLAB Engine for Python.
metadata.notes: Generated on macOS arm64 with MATLAB R2025a; k-Wave C++ OpenMP binary v1.4.1 as distributed with k-wave-python 0.6.2 (decision D-10 in the pyproteus repository). Values are stored with MATLAB's array sizes; read them with pyproteus or h5py (see docs/REFERENCE_DATA.md).
